commands.name: status
commands.description:
Check if AppEngine is online and report its running mode.

Examples:
  aetool status
  aetool status -u https://myserver:54001
  aetool status -u https://myserver:54001 --cfg-url https://myserver:54002

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance (e.g. https://localhost:54001). [default: https://localhost:54001]

options.name: --cfg-url
options.description: URL of the AppEngine instance in configuration mode. [default: https://localhost:54001]

commands.name: companies
commands.description:
List companies and their status from AppEngine.

Examples:
  aetool companies --user admin --password pass
  aetool companies --user admin --password pass --all
  aetool companies -u https://myserver:54001 --user admin --password pass

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

options.name: --all
options.description: Show all companies (including inactive). By default only active companies are shown. [default: False]

commands.name: plugins
commands.description:
List active plugins for a given company.

Examples:
  aetool plugins --user admin --password pass -c 1508
  aetool plugins -u https://myserver:54001 --user admin --password pass -c 1508

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

commands.name: jobs
commands.description:
List job assignments with their status, company and plugin.

Examples:
  aetool jobs --user admin --password pass
  aetool jobs --user admin --password pass -c 1508
  aetool jobs --user admin --password pass -p CompuTec.KSeF
  aetool jobs --user admin --password pass -j CostRollUp1
  aetool jobs --user admin --password pass -c 1508 -p CompuTec.KSeF

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

options.name: --job
options.description: Filter by Job Definition ID (e.g. CT_KSEF_Send_SJ).

commands.name: job
commands.description:
Enable, disable or unsuspend job assignments.

Examples:
  aetool job disable --user admin --password pass -c 1508 -j CostRollUp1
  aetool job enable --user admin --password pass -c 1508 -p CompuTec.KSeF
  aetool job unsuspend --user admin --password pass -j CT_KSEF_Send_SJ

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

options.name: --job
options.description: Filter by Job Definition ID (e.g. CT_KSEF_Send_SJ).

arguments.name: ACTION
arguments.description: Action to perform: enable, disable, unsuspend.

commands.name: update-company
commands.description:
Update (activate) a company on AppEngine - installs/updates core tables.

Examples:
  aetool update-company --user admin --password pass -c 1508
  aetool update-company --user admin --password pass -c 1508 --reinstall
  aetool update-company --user admin --password pass -c 1508 --no-wait

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

options.name: --sld-user
options.description: SLD username (defaults to admin username if not specified).

options.name: --sld-password
options.description: SLD password (defaults to admin password if not specified).

options.name: --reinstall
options.description: Reinstall all plugins on the company. [default: False]

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Do not wait for the task to complete, return immediately after submitting. [default: False]

commands.name: install-plugin
commands.description:
Download and install a plugin with all dependencies on a company.

Examples:
  aetool install-plugin --user admin --password pass -c 1508 --plugin CompuTec.ProcessForce.Plugin --version 3.2603.1
  aetool install-plugin --user admin --password pass -c 1508 --plugin CompuTec.ProcessForce.Plugin --version 3.2603.1 --no-wait

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

options.name: --ae-guid
options.description: AppEngine instance GUID. Auto-detected from company assignment if not specified.

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Do not wait for the install task to complete. [default: False]

commands.name: discover
commands.description:
Discover an SLD server and register its companies in AppEngine.

Examples:
  aetool discover --user admin --password pass --sld-address sqldev:40000 --sld-user B1SiteUser --sld-password pass --license localhost:30002
  aetool discover --user admin --password pass --sld-address sqldev:40000 --sld-user B1SiteUser --sld-password pass --license localhost:30002 --description "Production SLD"

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

options.name: --no-save
options.description: Do not save discovered data to AppEngine database. [default: False]

commands.name: config
commands.description:
Display AppEngine configuration (OIDC, CORS, MCP, EventBus, Plugin Repository, etc.).

Examples:
  ct-ae config --user admin --password pass
  ct-ae config --user admin --password pass -u https://myserver:54001

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]

commands.name: restart
commands.description:
Restart the AppEngine service.

Examples:
  ct-ae restart --user admin --password pass
  ct-ae restart --user admin --password pass -u https://myserver:54001

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of the AppEngine instance. [default: https://localhost:54001]
